answer: The knoll receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a terrace seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 90 aliases trips the duplicate check at the inlet gate. Honest users pay that once, farms 29 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
